name: Hejkal
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Hejkal, the human-sized forest wild-man demon of Czech folklore.
ANATOMY: ONE male head with fierce eyes, TWO arms and TWO legs, entire body densely covered in dark fur and moss, conspicuous bunch of ferns on head. Fully opaque fur conceals body. [hejkal-c02]
MOMENT: Leap toward viewer from a tree root, limbs splayed, mouth in terrifying halloo.
POWER: No magic effects; documented terrifying call and pouncing attack conveyed through open mouth and active leap. [hejkal-c01,hejkal-c02]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle, subject fills80% of square; natural scale unless giant explicitly documented. Important features clear at200pixels.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant warm moonbreak/sunset or documented lantern, dramatic rim light, deep walnut shadows, natural moisture/dust.
SURFACE: tactile natural skin/fur/scales/wood where appropriate, opaque coarse textiles, rough stone, original visible painterly brushwork.
SETTING: Czech forest near Plzeň; branches/ferns establish normal human size. [hejkal-c02]
MOOD: dangerous for hostile beings, awe-inspiring and respectful for gods, guardians and living traditions, never cute/calm/decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text/lettering/logo/border/frame/watermark; no extra heads/limbs/fingers; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outlines, energy ribbons, floating runes.

aura: Distinctive anatomy hejkal-c02 and documented action hejkal-c01,hejkal-c02.
artistic_choices: Dark warm palette and close low camera are editorial composition, no unsupported giant size or magic.
Opaque garments and restrained original design preserve modesty and respectful treatment.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native and200px inspected: one human wild-man head, two arms/two legs, densely fur/moss-covered body and fern bunch on head c02. Human size from tree/ferns, forward leap with terrifying shout c01/c02. Opaque fur, no horns/extra limbs, aura/text/gore; threatening action reads at200px. All seven Sangar checks pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px + 200px + hand, face and leg crops. A Slavic forest demon as a wild man whose entire body is covered in matted fur, moss and hanging vegetation with bark-like gnarled limbs (hejkal-c02/c11); a conspicuous crown of ferns sits on his head (hejkal-c02). One bearded male head with the mouth wide open in the terrifying call it is named for (hejkal-c01). Exactly two arms (the near reaching hand confirmed with thumb + four fingers, no extras) and two legs, a broad toed foot gripping a mossy log as he lunges toward a low camera through a conifer forest at sunset (hejkal-c01/c02). Normal fern scale, close framing rather than a giant; no victim, gore, invented magic, aura, text or borrowed design.
